PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Results-driven Product Owner with 8+ years of end-to-end product lifecycle ownership and 14+ years of deep domain expertise 
in investment banking and financial services. Proven track record of driving digital transformation and product strategy across 
tier-1 BFSI institutions — including a $4M revenue-generating product initiative at Wells Fargo (FY2025). Expert in translating 
complex regulatory and business requirements into sprint-ready user stories, acceptance criteria, and epics using Agile / Scrum 
frameworks. Skilled at backlog management, roadmap ownership, stakeholder management, KPI tracking, UAT, and go-to-
market planning. Backed by 6+ years of cross-functional leadership spanning operations, compliance, and technology teams. 
Proficient in JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, SQL, Power BI, and Miro. CSPO and PSPO I certified.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Product Owner  (Senior Business Execution Consultant) Jun 2020 – Present 
Wells Fargo EGS India Pvt. Ltd.  |  Bengaluru 
Product Highlights 
• $4M revenue-generating product initiative (FY2025): Owned the full product lifecycle from vision and roadmap through 
backlog definition, sprint execution, API integration sign-off, and go-live — delivering measurable business value within a 
regulated BFSI environment. 
• Digital transformation leadership: Drove end-to-end product strategy for a workflow digitisation initiative; defined epics, 
user stories, and acceptance criteria in JIRA, aligned roadmap to OKRs, and facilitated cross-functional discovery workshops 
using VoC inputs and stakeholder co-creation sessions. 
• Compliance-by-design: Embedded KYC/AML, FINRA, and regulatory data-flow requirements directly into the product 
backlog, ensuring zero compliance rework at UAT and release stage — a critical capability for BFSI product delivery. 
Core Responsibilities 
• Led all Agile / Scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives 
— maintaining cadence, velocity tracking, and Definition of Done (DoD) and Definition of Ready (DoR) standards across 
multiple concurrent workstreams. 
• Managed a prioritised product backlog of 100+ user stories applying MoSCoW and WSJF frameworks to maximise business 
value per sprint; maintained full traceability from epic to story to acceptance criteria. 
• Acted as single point of accountability for product quality and UAT: planned test scenarios, coordinated UAT cycles, tracked 
defects in JIRA, and signed off releases against defined KPIs — reducing post-release defect rate significantly. 
• Partnered with business, technology, UX, and compliance stakeholders to align on product priorities, resolve cross-team 
dependencies, and maintain delivery velocity without compromising regulatory standards. 
• Defined and reported product OKRs, KPIs, and sprint metrics to senior stakeholders; used Power BI dashboards and data 
analysis to make data-informed backlog prioritisation decisions and feed post-release performance insights back into 
future roadmap planning. 
• Facilitated product discovery workshops with business, UX, and VoC inputs — mapping customer journeys, validating 
assumptions, and shaping go-to-market readiness for each release increment. 
• Collaborated with engineering on API integration user stories and data-flow specifications, applying technical product 
knowledge to write precise acceptance criteria that eliminated ambiguity during development. 
Associate Manager — Digital Onboarding & Fund Operations Jun 2015 – Jun 2020 
State Street HCL Services  |  Bengaluru 
Product & Process Leadership 
• Shaped the end-to-end client onboarding product lifecycle: led KYC/AML journey design, defined SLAs and process 
requirements, and drove process re-engineering initiatives that measurably improved SLA adherence for institutional 
clients. 
• Designed and delivered KPI dashboards and management reporting (Power BI / Excel) to give leadership real-time visibility 
into onboarding pipeline health, compliance status, and throughput — a direct precursor to product analytics ownership. 
• Led a cross-functional team of 6+ spanning operations, compliance, and technology; coordinated stakeholder 
requirements, managed escalations, and delivered onboarding outcomes within regulated AIFMD fund environments. 
• Authored detailed process documentation and system enhancement specifications to support technology teams in 
implementing onboarding workflow improvements with precision and minimal ambiguity. 
• Conducted exception analysis and root-cause investigation on onboarding breaks; implemented systemic process fixes to 
drive continuous improvement across the onboarding funnel. 
• Managed fund accounting operations including NAV calculation, FX validation, and Mark-to-Market valuations for AIFMD-
regulated funds, building the regulatory compliance and investment operations expertise that underpins product decision-
making at Wells Fargo today. 
Operations Analyst — Reconciliation & Reporting Aug 2011 – Jun 2015 
JP Morgan Services India Pvt. Ltd.  |  Bengaluru 
• Built foundational investment banking expertise across cash and position reconciliation for Pension and Mutual Funds using 
TLM, Cosmic, Titan, Bloomberg, and Citrix — resolving daily breaks within strict SLA timelines. 
• Contributed to a reconciliation process improvement initiative that identified systemic breaks across the trade lifecycle, 
implemented targeted fixes, and measurably reduced exception volumes — an early demonstration of a product and 
problem-solving mindset. 
• Managed regulatory reporting and internal audit queries for global investment banking clients, collaborating with onshore 
and offshore counterparts to ensure accuracy and compliance within SLA timelines.
